application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions: The tree is situated in the rear garden of 22 Kingsend. The mature silver birch appears to be in a good condition and can be viewed from 22 Kingsend, neighbouring properties and from Sovereign Close. The tree, due to its condition and location has a moderate to high amenity value.
This application has been refused as no arboricultural justification has been provided. The proposed works do not seek to address tree health, structural condition, or safety concerns.

Silver birch is a species known to compartmentalise poorly, and unnecessary pruning can lead to decline and increased future management requirements. The crown reduction of a healthy tree with an intact maiden crown would therefore represent an avoidable intervention, resulting in harm to the tree's natural form and a reduction in amenity value.
Please note, the removal of deadwood is exempt from the application process and may be carried out.
